title: Confirmation titles and first lines: bulk selection vs a single part
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Open the confirmation from a selection of several parts, of exactly one part, and from a single part's edit dialog.
  2. Read each title and opening line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • From a selection the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" / "Activate parts?" and opens "{n} parts selected." (or "1 part selected."); from one part's edit dialog it is titled "Deactivate part?" / "Activate part?" and opens with that part's number followed by its name.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R20: “The confirmation raised from a selection on the list is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". The confirmation raised from one part's edit dialog is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-R21: “The confirmation raised from a selection opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. The confirmation raised from one part's edit dialog opens with that part's number followed by its name.”
